name: Security Event Audit Logger
description: Fires whenever a specified security rule executes (rule_fired trigger), then logs the event to syslog and MQTT — but only if the system is armed OR the motion counter is above zero (condition_logic: OR). Demonstrates the rule_fired trigger, condition_logic OR, counter condition, and variable_compare condition used together.

actions.message: Security audit: rule fired on {{camera.serial}} at {{timestamp}} — armed={{var.system.armed}}, motion_count={{counter.motion_count}}
